part.name: Tapered linkage arm with clevis and hook end
part.description: Long tapered arm/lever with a forked clevis (split lug) pin-joint interface on one end and a rounded hooked/seat interface on the opposite end. Prismatic body with drafted faces and localized cylindrical features at both ends.
part.symmetry_note: Largely symmetric about the mid-plane y=0 (left/right across width), with paired clevis lugs and mirrored side geometry. Not symmetric along length (different end interfaces).

Section.name: Clevis fork / pin-joint end
features included: Split fork with central slot (clevis opening)
Two coaxial pin holes (one per lug)
Inner lug faces defining slot width
Section.function intent: Provide a pin-joint mounting interface to connect the arm to a mating clevis/pin assembly while allowing rotation about the pin axis.
Section.physical behavior: Transfers primarily shear and bearing loads through the lug holes into the arm; the split lugs resist spreading via section thickness and surrounding material, while rounded outer ends reduce stress concentrations at the lug tips.
Section.geometry: Two parallel lugs separated by a rectangular slot; each lug has a cylindrical through-hole. Lug tips have a larger-radius cylindrical outer profile; the slot terminates at a planar end wall.
Section.location: Left end of the part (negative X extreme, around x ≈ -75.75 mm).

major_faces.name: Upper lug pin-hole cylinder
major_faces.description: Cylindrical bore surface for the pin in the upper lug (axis along Y, r=3).

major_faces.name: Lower lug pin-hole cylinder
major_faces.description: Cylindrical bore surface for the pin in the lower lug (axis along Y, r=3).

major_faces.name: Slot end wall
major_faces.description: Planar wall closing the clevis slot at its inner end (plane normal -X).

major_faces.name: Inner face of lower lug (slot side)
major_faces.description: Planar inner side face defining one side of the clevis slot (y=-3.5).

major_faces.name: Inner face of upper lug (slot side)
major_faces.description: Planar inner side face defining the other side of the clevis slot (y=+3.5).

major_faces.name: Outer perimeter cylinder of lower lug tip
major_faces.description: Large-radius cylindrical outer surface forming the rounded end of the lower lug (axis along Y, r=7.5).

major_faces.name: Outer perimeter cylinder of upper lug tip
major_faces.description: Large-radius cylindrical outer surface forming the rounded end of the upper lug (axis along Y, r=7.5).

Section.name: Tapered arm body
Section.function intent: Transmit load/motion between the clevis end and the hook end while minimizing mass via taper and maintaining stiffness.
Section.physical behavior: Acts as a beam in bending and axial tension/compression; taper and drafted faces distribute stresses and reduce peak bending stress toward the thinner end while maintaining adequate section near the clevis end.
Section.geometry: Four dominant long planar faces (top, bottom, and two side faces) forming a tapered solid that transitions between the two end interfaces; faces are slightly angled (draft) relative to global axes.
Section.location: Central span connecting left clevis end to right hook end (dominant length along X).

major_faces.name: Bottom face (drafted)
major_faces.description: Large planar bottom surface of the arm/body with slight draft (normal mostly -Z).

major_faces.name: Left side face (negative Y side)
major_faces.description: Large planar side surface on -Y side; slightly drafted (normal mostly -Y).

major_faces.name: Top face (drafted)
major_faces.description: Large planar top surface of the arm/body with slight draft (normal mostly +Z).

major_faces.name: Right side face (positive Y side)
major_faces.description: Large planar side surface on +Y side; slightly drafted (normal mostly +Y).

Section.name: Hook / rounded end interface
features included: Rounded end boss (large cylindrical outer surface)
Local side/end faces defining the open notch
Section.function intent: Provide an engagement/seat feature at the tip of the arm for hooking onto or locating a mating rod/cable/feature, while providing clearance for insertion and contact on curved surfaces.
Section.physical behavior: Carries localized contact forces at the seat/notch and transfers them into the arm; curved outer boss reduces edge contact and stress concentration; end faces bound the notch and help constrain lateral motion of the mating feature.
Section.geometry: A bulb/rounded end defined by a large-radius cylindrical outer surface, with a smaller-radius cylindrical concavity/seat and additional small cylindrical patch; bounded by small planar end faces and a top planar face.
Section.location: Right end of the part (positive X extreme, around x ≈ +75.75 mm).

major_faces.name: Outer rounded boss cylinder
major_faces.description: Large cylindrical outer surface forming the rounded end/bulb (axis along Y, r=9).

major_faces.name: Concave seat / notch cylinder
major_faces.description: Smaller cylindrical surface forming the inner seat/notch curvature (axis along Y, r=3).

major_faces.name: Small cylindrical patch near top of end
major_faces.description: Short cylindrical surface segment (axis along Y, r=3) associated with local rounding/transition at the end feature.

major_faces.name: Top end pad face
major_faces.description: Planar top face at z=15 forming the top boundary of the end feature.

major_faces.name: End-side face (positive Y, small)
major_faces.description: Small planar face at y=+3 bounding the end feature/notch region.

major_faces.name: Vertical end rounding cylinder
major_faces.description: Cylindrical surface with axis along Z (r=3) forming a rounded vertical edge at the extreme end.

major_faces.name: End-side face (negative Y, small)
major_faces.description: Small planar face at y=-3 bounding the end feature/notch region.
